notes.title: PathBlasters first update (1.0.1) is here!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we're pleased to release a new update for PathBlasters!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44134611/a6089595f7e58d818e09d6b5d1b3cfe31751d7e1.gif

The biggest feature here is Leaderboards.

It comes in 3 modes: infinite, time attack and score attack. There is one leaderboard per level, and infinite mode has different ones for each difficulty mode. And you can filter them in Friends, Global and Top!

Other impactful improvements are:


 A new hard difficulty in infinite mode!
 Earn pixons when obtaining new medals.
 Earn also more and more pixons as you go far in infinite mode!
 We added many sounds that were missing in the released version.
 Displaying a "3,2,1" timer at the end of score attack timer.
 Controls menu is now available from multiplayer ingame menus (not in solo as they are always available in the bottom left corner of the screen)


We also added credits in the game menu!

Here is an overview of the bug fixes:


 Fixed volume control (now linear while it was decreasing too fast along the slider).
 Many bug fixes in the menu flows.
 Fixed the characters sliding while summoning cristals
 Localization fixes.
 Fixed guardian's color which became black under certain conditions.
 Score attack: now waiting for all the points to be taken into account before playing the end screen.

notes.title: 24h Steam playtest tomorrow!
notes.content:
We try another format for this week's playtest: it will last 24h!


Starting from tomorrow Tuesday November 28th 10am (UTC+1)
Ending Wednesday 29th 10am (UTC+1) on PC!

(check your timezone here)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44134611/d5a65c422233a647ebddc8784da5a52d5b4a76fb.gif
(for the first time, all three characters are available for this session!)

How to participate?

Same as last week, click on "Request access" on the PathBlasters Steam page
Access to the playtests will be granted progressively over the sessions and you'll receive an email when you are selected.

If you're not selected this time, you'll have to be patient - we're still planning a number of sessions very soon!


Playtest procedure and rules

Reach our Discord to find other players and discuss about the game.
Playtests on PC via Steam, you can use a keyboard or any other game controller
Feel free (if you like) to come here on Discord and broadcast your game session live, it's very useful for us!
Concerning the multiplayer mode, you can either play locally with a friend, or online by sharing a lobby code here with someone else who has access to the playtest.
Please don't forget to fill the playtest end form linked in the game to give us some feedbacks!


See you soon!

notes.title: Starting Steam playtests tomorrow
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are happy to announce that we will have weekly playtest sessions, starting on tomorrow Tuesday November 21th from 7pm to 9:30pm UTC+1 on PC!
(check your timezone here)

We will now organize these playtests every Tuesday (with a few exceptions). PathBlasters being still under development, our goal is to collect as much feedback as possible, find bugs, and know how you feel about the current state of the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44134611/7292cb548bbc9637aae0ae85508acf570dd97263.gif

How to participate?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44134611/68a224c4de4063fee6e8cbfee76921d5abc2c5d2.png
Go to the PathBlasters Steam page and click on “Request access”
Access to the playtests will be granted progressively over the sessions. You will receive an email on your Steam account when this happens.
If you're not selected this time, you'll have to be patient - we're still planning a number of sessions very soon!


Playtest procedure
Here are the rules to follow and how the playtests will work:

Playtests on PC via Steam
Players can use the keyboard or any other game controller
Feel free (if you like) to come to the game's Discord and broadcast your game session live, it's very useful for us!
First 40 minutes (7pm to 7:40pm), single-player mode will be the main focus
Second 40 minutes: (7:40pm to 8:20pm), online versus mode will be favored (come on Discord to share game codes!)
Then for 1h50 (8:20pm to 9:30pm), time spent filling in the playtest feedback form and/or giving feedback to the development team on Discord!


Many thanks to all those who will be taking part!

The PathBlasters team
